rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When a feminine noun is intended to mean a masculine concept, masculine agreement is permitted by carrying the verb over to the intended meaning.
rows.anchor: فإذا قصدنا باللفظ المؤنّث معنى المذكّر جاز تذكيره وهو ما يُعرف بالحمل على المعنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He reads masculine حق عليهم الضلالة as punishment: the return to the afterlife means people are not truly astray there, since everything is disclosed.
rows.anchor: ونرى أنه في كل مرة يذكر فيها الضلالة بالتذكير تكون الضلالة بمعنى العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With feminine agreement, the context is worldly life and الضلالة means misguidance itself, so the verb agrees with the feminine noun.
rows.anchor: وعندما تكون الضلالة بالتأنيث يكون الكلام في الدنيا فلمّا كانت الضلالة بمعناها هي يؤنّث الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Against Orientalist criticism based on differing versions of Moses’ story, the same scene can be expressed in many ways, but their rhetorical artistry is unequal and no wording matches the Quran.
rows.anchor: القصة الواحدة في القرآن قد يُعبّر عنها بصور مختلفة لكن اختيار الصورة المعجزة هو اختيار القرآن الكريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran gives an exact, artistically miraculous rendering of what prophets meant; Moses had difficulty expressing himself and asked for Aaron, who was more eloquent.
rows.anchor: لأن موسى كان في لسانه عجمة (ولا يكاد يُبين) كما جاء على لسان فرعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inimitability challenge applies even to a very short surah such as al-Kawthar, whose eloquent choices cannot be reproduced.
rows.anchor: فلا يمكن صياغة سورة مثل سور القرآن الكريم حتى لو كان المحتوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The imperfect verb signals recurrence: the intentional killer may kill whenever an opportunity arises.
rows.anchor: كلما سنحت له الفرصة قتل وهذا دليل التكرار لذا جاء الفعل بصيغة المضارع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gratitude is in the imperfect because it recurs at every moment for God’s blessings, while disbelief is in the perfect because it happens once.
rows.anchor: صيغة المضارع لأن الشكر يكون في كل لحظة على كل نعم الله أما (ومن كفر) جاء بصيغة الماضي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The present tense marks repeated requests for money, whereas the past tense marks Moses’ one-time question after which he would leave the companion.
rows.anchor: سؤال متكرر لأن سؤال الأموال متكرر فجاء الفعل بصيغة المضارع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The brothers say the wolf ate Joseph rather than preyed on him: predation should have torn his clothes, but they showed his shirt with false blood.
rows.anchor: جاءوا على قميصه بدم كذب فدلّ ذلك على أن الذئب لم يفترسه لذا جاء فعل (فأكله)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fronting هم restricts the negation to this group and implies that others grieve; the contrast is like denying that I struck him while implying someone else did.
rows.anchor: بتقديم (هم) الذين يحزن غيرهم وليس هم. نفي الفعل عن النفس ولكنه إثبات الفعل لشخص آخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The paired wording negates both settled and renewed fear and grief; alternate formulations would not carry the intended full scope.
rows.anchor: فنفى الخوف المتجدد والثابت ونفى الحزن المتجدد (لا هم يحزنون بمعنى لا يخافون)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Trade comes first because the congregation left for a caravan during a period of high prices; amusement comes first in the closing clause because it distracts more people, though God’s provision is better than both.
rows.anchor: فكثير ينشغلون باللهو وما عند الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fatir repeats the preposition with الزبر and الكتاب for emphasis and detail in a context of warning, calling, and conveying the message.
rows.anchor: المقام في سورة فاطر مقام التوكيد والتفصيل بخلاف ما ورد في سورة آل عمران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aal Imran omits the repeated preposition for concision because the verse answers a specific historical exchange, rather than developing the broader warning context of Fatir.
rows.anchor: أما في سورة آل عمران فالآية تعقيب على محادثة تاريخية معينة

words: لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا
rows.speaker: قالوا
rows.claim: They explain the order benefit then harm in 13:16 by the preceding order willing then unwilling prostration in 13:15.
rows.anchor: وذلك لتقدم قوله تعالى (وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا

rows.speaker: قالوا
rows.claim: They explain the same benefit-before-harm order in Saba by the preceding mention of God expanding provision before restricting it.
rows.anchor: فقدّم النفع على الضر قالوا: وذلك لتقدم قوله (قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ

words: يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ
غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ
rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A reported pattern is that Quranic pairings mention mercy or forgiveness before punishment, as in these three verses.
rows.anchor: فقد قيل إنه حيث ذكر الرحمة والعذاب بدأ بذكر الرحمة

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: The Prophet quotes God as saying, “My mercy preceded My wrath,” reinforcing the reported precedence of mercy.
rows.anchor: جاء قول النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - حكاية عن الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Isra places people before the Quran because its preceding passage discusses human beings and God’s favor to them before the Quran’s challenge to humans and jinn.
rows.anchor: فناسب تقديم الناس في سورة الإسراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kahf places the Quran before people because the surah opens with the revealed Book, then recounts stories of people, matching the order in the verse.
rows.anchor: فبدأ بذكر القرآن ثم ذكر الناس فكان المناسب أن يتقدم ذكر القرآن على الناس في هذه الآية كما في البدء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Isra’s opening moves from the Night Journey to the Children of Israel and then the Quran at 17:9, so its people-first order suits the surah’s opening sequence.
rows.anchor: فكان المناسب أن يتقدم ذكر الناس فيها على ذكر القرآن في هذه الآية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Isra’s closing ingratitude fits its preceding account of divine favor: kufur is denial of blessings, the opposite of gratitude, as in the grateful-or-ungrateful contrast in 76:3.
rows.anchor: والكفور هو جحد النعم فناسب ذلك تقدم ذكر النعمة والرحمة والفضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kahf’s close about human argument matches its dialogues and disputes, including the garden companions, the disbelievers, and Moses with the righteous servant; Isra contains no such debate language.
rows.anchor: ولم يرد لفظ الجدل ولا المحاورة في سورة الإسراء كلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An-Nisa repeats ب with ذي القربى because the surah’s broader subject is kinship, adding emphasis and detail; Baqara omits it for concision because that is not its context.
rows.anchor: ذكر الباء مع ذي القربى في هذه الآية من سورة النساء كان لمراعاة التفضيل والتوكيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shift from singular address in the description to the first-person plural in فأخرجنا is iltifāt, used to refresh the listener’s attention; shifts also occur across person and number.
rows.anchor: هذا يسمى التفاف ويستعمل لتطرية نشاط السامع وقد ورد في القرآن كثيراً

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: جيوبهن means the opening at the chest.
rows.anchor: ما معنى جيوبهن؟ الجيب هو فتحة الصدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In 63:10 أكن is jussive although فأصدق is subjunctive; this is coordination by meaning rather than matching case endings.
rows.anchor: (أكن) عطف مجزوم على منصوب (فأصّدق) هذا يسمى في النحو عطف على المعنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fā after the request particle لولا is the causal fā, making the following verb subjunctive; without fā, the response to the request would be jussive, as in تلقف in 20:69.
rows.anchor: الفاء في كلمة (فأصدق) تُسمّى فاء السببية في النحو التي تقع بعد الطلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The differing cases carry both cause and condition: the speaker promises charity and makes becoming righteous a self-imposed condition if granted more time.
rows.anchor: أراد أن يجمع المعنيين السبب والشرط أي الإشتراط على النفس والإشتراط فيه توثيق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The case shift distinguishes the two aims: becoming righteous is greater and more comprehensive than giving charity, so it appears as a further condition after charity.
rows.anchor: كون الإنسان من الصالحين أكبر وأعظم من الصدقة وهو الأعم وهو الذي يدخل الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In 93:3, directly naming the Prophet in ما ودعك honors him, while omitting him as the object of قلى avoids directly associating him with hatred; mention and omission both honor him.
rows.anchor: فلم يقل (وما قلاك) حتى لا يكون الخطاب مباشرة للرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Verse endings are not always self-contained semantic units: meaning comes first, and a fāṣila may depend on what precedes or follows it.
rows.anchor: ليست الفواصل هي دائماً تامة المعنى فقد تكون متعلقة بما قبلها أوما بعدها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The source asks why the order of Aaron and Moses changes between Ta-Ha and Shuara and whether the change serves the fāṣila; this segment gives no answer.
rows.anchor: لماذا التقديم والتأخير وهل هو للفاصلة القرآنية؟

rows.speaker: المفسرون
rows.claim: Mufassirun say the water first burst out abundantly, then diminished because of the Israelites’ disobedience; both states occurred.
rows.anchor: وحسب ما يقوله المفسرون أن الماء انفجرت أولاً بالماء الكثير ثم قلّ الماء بمعاصيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Baqara’s praise of God’s favor uses انفجرت for abundant flow, while Araf’s censure of the Israelites uses انبجست, denoting less water.
rows.anchor: في سورة البقرة الذي يذكر الثناء والمدح والتفضّل على بني إسرائيل جاء بالكلمة التي تدل على الكثير

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Some explain the fā as marking sequence and immediate succession in the two descriptions.
rows.anchor: وبعضهم قال جاء بالفاء للترتيب والتعقيب في (فانفجرت) و (فانبجست)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He calls this fā the explicative fā that signals omitted but understood events, as in the unspoken striking of the stone, the steps after the command to go, and the Hudhud’s delivery of Solomon’s letter.
rows.anchor: هذه الفاء إذن هي فاء الفصيحة التي تدلّ على أن هناك محذوف ولكن المعنى واضح
